audience.text: C++ developers building desktop or server applications that need to parse, inspect, create, or transform Outlook MSG, CFB, and EML email formats without external runtime dependencies.

capabilities.text: Read, build, and write generic Compound File Binary containers directly through cfb_reader, cfb_storage/cfb_stream, and cfb_writer, working with file paths, in-memory streams, or raw byte buffers.
capabilities.title: Low-level CFB access

capabilities.text: Parse and reconstruct the raw MSG directory/stream structure with msg_reader, msg_document, and msg_writer, including an optional strict-validation mode surfaced through validation_issues().
capabilities.title: Low-level MSG document model

capabilities.text: Create, edit, save, and reload Outlook-style messages through mapi_message, setting subject, plain-text and HTML bodies, and sender identity, or reaching arbitrary MAPI properties via set_property()/get_property_value().
capabilities.title: High-level message authoring

capabilities.text: Add To/Cc/Bcc recipients with add_recipient(), attach regular files from byte buffers or streams with add_attachment(), and nest a full mapi_message as an embedded-message attachment with add_embedded_message_attachment().
capabilities.title: Recipients and attachments

capabilities.text: Save an in-memory mapi_message to .eml and load .eml back into a mapi_message, both through the library's own MIME engine, with no external MIME dependency.
capabilities.title: MSG/EML interoperability

limitations.text: No SMTP, IMAP, POP3, or other network mail-protocol support — this library reads and writes MSG, CFB, and EML containers and messages already on disk, in memory, or in a stream; it is not a mail client or transport library.
No PST (Outlook Personal Folders) archive support — only single MSG-format messages and generic CFB containers are supported, not multi-message PST stores.
Only a curated subset of MAPI properties has a dedicated named accessor on mapi_message; every other property must be read and written through the generic get_property_value()/set_property() pair.

problems_solved.text: Enables deterministic, byte-level generation and parsing of MSG, CFB, and EML files in C++ without pulling in third-party libraries.
Provides both high-level message authoring via mapi_message and low-level structural access via msg_reader/msg_document/msg_writer and cfb_reader/cfb_document/cfb_writer.
Supports MSG-to-EML and EML-to-MSG conversion using the library's own MIME engine, with no external MIME dependency.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Email FOSS for C++ is a C++17 library for reading and writing binary email containers and messages — Compound File Binary (CFB) containers, Outlook MSG documents, and RFC 5322 / MIME EML files — with deterministic, byte-level output and no third-party library dependency of its own.

uncertainties: The exact set of MAPI properties supported via named accessors on mapi_message is not listed in the fact dossier.
The behavior of strict-validation mode in msg_reader/msg_document is not detailed beyond the presence of validation_issues().
Whether the library supports Unicode-only or mixed Unicode/ANSI strings in MSG files is not explicitly stated.
The exact MIME handling behavior for non-standard or malformed EML files is not specified.
The versioning scheme and compatibility guarantees for the public API surface are not detailed in the facts.
The behavior of embedded-message attachments when the embedded message itself contains nested attachments is not specified.
Whether the library supports CFB streams larger than available memory is not stated.
The thread-safety guarantees of concurrent access to mapi_message or low-level readers/writers are not provided.

workflows.name: Read MSG subject from file
workflows.text: Open a .msg file as a binary stream and extract the subject using the mapi_message API.

workflows.name: Create and save message as MSG and EML
workflows.text: Create a message programmatically, set subject/body/sender, and save it to both .msg and .eml formats.

workflows.name: Inspect low-level MSG/CFB structure
workflows.text: Use msg_reader and msg_document to walk the underlying CFB directory/stream structure and render it as text.

workflows.name: Build and run examples
workflows.text: Enable ASPOSE_EMAIL_FOSS_BUILD_EXAMPLES in CMake to build runnable CLI examples in the examples/ directory.

workflows.name: Run tests
workflows.text: Enable ASPOSE_EMAIL_FOSS_BUILD_TESTS in CMake to build and run three CTest-registered test executables.
